mapper.select: WITH planned AS ( SELECT ms.account_id,r.ingredient_id,r.supplier_product_id,r.base_unit, SUM(r.total_required_qty) planned_qty,SUM(r.calculated_cost) planned_cost FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_ingredient_requirement r JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service ms ON ms.meal_service_id=r.meal_service_id WHERE ms.account_id=#{account_id} AND ms.table_id=#{table_id} AND ms.status!='CANCELED' GROUP BY ms.account_id,r.ingredient_id,r.supplier_product_id,r.base_unit ), stock AS ( SELECT account_id,account_ingredient_product_id,SUM(current_base_qty) current_qty FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance WHERE account_id=#{account_id} GROUP BY account_id,account_ingredient_product_id ) SELECT r.*,p.product_name ingredient_name,p.supplier_item_code,p.order_unit,COALESCE(ap.link_base_qty,p.base_qty) convert_value, ap.account_ingredient_product_id,COALESCE(s.current_qty,0) current_qty, COALESCE(ap.safe_stock_base_qty,0) safe_stock_qty, GREATEST(r.planned_qty+COALESCE(ap.safe_stock_base_qty,0)-COALESCE(s.current_qty,0),0) shortage_qty, CEIL(GREATEST(r.planned_qty+COALESCE(ap.safe_stock_base_qty,0)-COALESCE(s.current_qty,0),0)/NULLIF(COALESCE(ap.link_base_qty,p.base_qty),0)) suggested_order_qty, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.current_qty,0)<r.planned_qty THEN 'RED' WHEN COALESCE(s.current_qty,0)<r.planned_qty+COALESCE(ap.safe_stock_base_qty,0) THEN 'ORANGE' ELSE 'GREEN' END stock_status FROM planned r LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=r.supplier_product_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap ON ap.account_id=r.account_id AND ap.supplier_product_id=r.supplier_product_id LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.account_id=ap.account_id AND s.account_ingredient_product_id=ap.account_ingredient_product_id ORDER BY r.ingredient_id,r.supplier_product_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(planned_servings),0) total_servings, COALESCE(SUM(meal_budget_per_person*planned_servings)/NULLIF(SUM(planned_servings),0),0) meal_budget_per_person FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND table_id=#{table_id} AND status!='CANCELED'
